gaps.sentence: If you had set an alarm, you ___.
gaps.explanation: The present result of a past unreal condition takes 'would not be': would not still be asleep.

gaps.sentence: You'd have got a better exchange rate ___ at the bank instead of the airport.
gaps.explanation: The unreal past condition takes 'if + past perfect'.

gaps.sentence: If the route ___ safer, I would cycle to work.
gaps.hint: an imaginary present situation, subjunctive were
gaps.explanation: Unreal present conditions formally take 'were' rather than 'is': were.

gaps.sentence: I will tell her the news when I ___ her at the party.
gaps.hint: when clauses take present for future
gaps.explanation: Time clauses with future meaning use the present simple, not 'will': see.

gaps.sentence: I wish I ___ so much cake — I feel sick now.
gaps.hint: past act with a present consequence
gaps.explanation: The regret is about a past action, so 'wish' takes the past perfect: had not eaten.

gaps.sentence: You will not pass the course unless you ___ all the assignments.
gaps.hint: unless means if not, present simple
gaps.explanation: 'Unless' introduces a negative condition and takes the present simple: complete.

gaps.sentence: He always carries a power bank in case his phone ___.
gaps.hint: in case plus the present simple
gaps.explanation: 'In case' takes the present simple for things that might happen: dies.

gaps.sentence: If the drug ___ tested properly, the side effects would have been found earlier.
gaps.hint: passive verb in an unreal past condition
gaps.explanation: The unreal past condition takes the past perfect, here in the passive: had been.
